auth.login.title: Log in

auth.forgot.mail_unavailable: Email sending is not set up. Use the FTP way.
auth.forgot.mail_invalid: The link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
auth.ftp.intro: This proves you have access to the server.

auth.ftp.step2: Open the data/ folder. It sits next to the public/ folder.
auth.ftp.step3: Create an empty file there with exactly this name:
auth.ftp.step4: Click “Check”. Then set a new password.

Hello,

your confirmation code is: {code}

Bioly

Hello,

use this link to set a new password:
{link}

Bioly

editor.header.avatar.done: Image uploaded and saved in the media library.
legal.title: Legal
legal.intro: Imprint and privacy policy, as own text or as a link.

media.intro: All images and own icons in one place, with names and alt texts.
